subject: CAIQ: data retention evidence & control ownership
messages:
From: Erin Bailey <erin.bailey@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: data retention evidence & control owners

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking this — ClearWater Health is working through your CAIQ and we have a few focused asks around data retention controls (CCM section DR/PR/DI related items). Specifically, the auditors want: 

- The company retention policy that governs logs, model artifacts, customer data and backups (policy + effective date).
- Evidence of S3 lifecycle or backup retention settings (screenshots or config exports).
- DB TTL / archival configuration examples for tenant-scoped tables (sample SQL/config).
- Log rotation and retention runbook or playbook (how logs are archived/purged).
- Control owner names for each of the above.

Can you share a small evidence package and point us to an owner we can follow up with? We’d like to close these items by Apr 22.

I can send an NDA/DocuSign for evidence transfer if you prefer.

Appreciate it,
Erin Bailey
Security & Compliance Lead
ClearWater Health

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Bailey <erin.bailey@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: data retention evidence & control owners

Hi Erin — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kim (security compliance) and Priyom (platform/infrastructure) to collect the artifacts.

Plan:
1) Kim will pull the retention policy and log runbook, mark the control owners and produce a short mapping doc.
2) Priyom will export screenshots/configs for S3 lifecycle and DB TTL examples.
3) We’ll package the artifacts and share via Drive + a zipped index by EOD Apr 19 for your review.

Can you confirm whether sample artifacts can include redacted identifiers (tenant ids)? If you need full raw artifacts we’ll coordinate an NDA/secure transfer.

Attachments I’ll ask the team to prepare: retention-policy.pdf, s3-lifecycle-screenshot.png, db-ttl-config.txt, log-rotation-runbook.pdf.

Avery Johnson
Manager, Security GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Erin Bailey <erin.bailey@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: data retention evidence & control owners

On Thu, Apr 15, 2027 at 10:12 AM Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Plan:
> 1) Kim will pull the retention policy and log runbook, mark the control owners and produce a short mapping doc.

Hi all — attaching the artifacts we agreed on. Quick notes and owners below.

Artifact inventory (attached to this thread):
- retention-policy.pdf — corporate data retention policy (owner: Kimberly Park, Director Security Compliance) — includes retention periods for logs, customer data, backups and model artifacts.
- log-rotation-runbook.pdf — on-call playbook for rotation/archival (owner: Priyom Das, Platform SRE).
- s3-lifecycle-screenshot.png — example bucket lifecycle showing 90-day transition to Glacier and 365-day expiry (owner: Priyom Das).
- db-ttl-config.txt — sanitized snippet of tenant table TTL config and archival job (owner: Priyom Das).

Delivery timeline: full zipped evidence + index will be uploaded to the Drive folder linked below by EOD Apr 19. If you want earlier access to any single artifact, tell us which one and we’ll push it up sooner.

Redaction note: we removed tenant identifiers and replaced with placeholders in db-ttl-config.txt; if auditors require non-redacted samples we need a signed confidentiality agreement / evidence handling checklist before transfer.

Link to staged folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-retention-evidence

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Erin Bailey <erin.bailey@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: data retention evidence & control owners

Thanks Kim — this looks good and the timeline works. Two small items: 

1) We’d like the DB TTL sample with tenant ids redacted is fine for initial review; however the auditor will likely request a single non-redacted sample under NDA. Please confirm you can provide that under a DocuSign/Confidentiality transfer (we can send the DocuSign link).

2) Can Priyom also include a timestamped export for the S3 lifecycle configuration (UTC timestamp in the screenshot or a small export file)? That helps with proof-of-state for the control.

We’re tentatively scheduling a 30m walkthrough on Apr 20 at 10:00 AM PT to run through any follow-ups — does that work?

If yes, I’ll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign confidentiality link: https://www.docusign.com/clearwater/confidentiality-nda-12345

Best,
Erin Bailey
Security & Compliance Lead
ClearWater Health
